title: Adriel
summary: Raleigh names Adriel in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Adriel, to whom Saul married Merab after hee had promised her to Dauid, and to whom she bare the fiue sonnes deliuered to the Gibeonites. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. I, sig. 292b–293a
